'''Rod Latham Bothawui Clouds''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls36.htm Bothawui Clouds], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002738/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls36.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
